issues.title: Course lesson videos not playing for students
issues.problem_statement: The customer's students say the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and the customer said this was the third time raising it; the customer hopes it gets sorted out.

evidence: It plays on Safari and on my phone too. So I cannot reproduce the problem from my side.
